description: From Kerkplein the Sint-Petrusbasiliek west tower rises about eighty metres. The lower stages alternate red brick and white marl. Above them a neo-Gothic octagonal lantern, small corner turrets, and a spire complete the crown. The sky is clear, about 14.8°C, with wind near 10.8 km/h. The viewpoint is Kerkplein, beside the market streets.
